convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom calls to BrainTrend2 and BrainTrend2Stop custom indicators which are not built-in MT5 indicators. Requires the custom .ex5 indicator files to function. Otherwise straightforward duplex (long+short) logic with fixed SL/TP.

params.indicator: BrainTrend2Stop used as dynamic trailing level

other_exits: BrainTrend2Stop indicator provides dynamic stop level that can close positions on signal reversal

custom_logic_notes: Duplex EA trades both long and short sides based on BrainTrend2 custom indicator signals. The BrainTrend2Stop indicator provides dynamic trailing stop levels. Signal reversal closes opposite position and opens new one in reversed direction. Typical BrainTrend2 logic uses ATR-based trailing with color-coded trend detection (blue=bullish, red=bearish). Entry signals are evaluated on completed bars (previous bar values using shift 1). Digit adjustment applied to SL/TP values for 5-digit/3-digit brokers.
python_conversion_notes: Requires reimplementation of BrainTrend2 and BrainTrend2Stop indicator logic in Python. BrainTrend2 is typically an ATR-based trend indicator with dynamic stop calculation. The original indicator algorithm must be sourced or reverse-engineered from the .mq5 source. Digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be handled. New bar detection using IsNewBar pattern must be replicated. Duplex means both long and short trades are allowed with signal-reversal close of opposite positions.
